notes.title: Early Access 0.37 : WE ARE ALMOST THERE
notes.content: [h2]Maps[/h2][list][*][p]Added 5 new maps : 4 in chapter 3 and 1 in Limbo,[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked all of the chapter 3 with new props and obstacles,[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked all of the Limbo chapter with new props and obstacles,[/p][/*][*][p]New lighting for chapter 2,[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked a small part of level 1-1,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay[/h2][list][*][p]New mechanic : the slide boost zone, it's a white zone on the ground that makes you slide a looot quicker,[/p][/*][*][p]New mechanic in limbo levels : the bouncing surface.. you'll see !,[/p][/*][*][p]New mechanic, the minimum speed ring : a speed ring that puts you to a certain speed if you have less than that speed (ex: a 50 min speed ring, will put you to 50 speed if you have 20, but won't do anything if you have 55),[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the air fans,[/p][/*][*][p]Required checkpoints : added required checkpoints in level 1-10 to test the mechanic !,[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the way speed is computed, now it's a real metric in meter/second,[/p][/*][*][p]When finishing a level and respawning, it respawns you with no speed next to the teleporter thanks to @Fixious,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Others[/h2][list][*][p]Reworked the medals logos !! (check the screenshot),[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed many animations of the ghosts,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug fixing[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the speed boost in Distant glade thanks to @Demon Bublebush , @kricket and @Fixious,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the menu opening when in freecam thanks to @william,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player could move while in menu thanks to @printer,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a weird ass bug when you had a slowdown after restarting a level, big thanks to @printer,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a 1 year old bug where the sound effect continued while on the ground thanks to @william,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed also a very old collision bug on overlook (a rock had a hole) thanks to @william,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the abuse from jumping from the sand at the start of the Passage thanks to @william,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the volume not off a -40db thanks to @william (I'll rework that better in the next update),[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an abuse in Green Moon thanks to @GreezyCheese,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Roadmap[/h2][list][*][p]NPCs and the whole writing and lore of Hoverflow, I didn't find time to include it in this update,[/p][/*][*][p]One more Limbo level,[/p][/*][*][p]Balance the medals of all of the levels,[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I am planning to release the v1.0 on November the 7th, thank you so much for helping me along this incredible journey  There may be one final update before 1.0. Rest assured, I have many plans for after 1.0 if there are enough players interested in the game ![/p]

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.11.0 : I am alive !

It's been two years exactly since the last update ! This one is a small one but I'm glad I'm working on the game again and I definitely intend to give it my best to finish it ! :)

[b]Gameplay :[/b]
- Reworked level 1 and 2

- Added moving secrets, they will try to escape from you !
- Added NPCs to teach you the basics of the game (I will remove videos from the tutorial in the near future) and also give you some insights about the world you are in !
- Added a len's flare that can be disabled within the options
- Reworked the particles for the first chapter
- Completly deleted the RetroControls option, I want old CS players to try the new inputs

[b]Next on the Roadmap :[/b]
- BHop visualization to make it clearer when the player will land (Thanks to @Alex.Fyve for the suggestion !)
- Jump buffering to avoid missing BHops (Thanks to @Alex.Fyve for the suggestion !)

[b]NOTE :[/b] The game size increased from 1.4GB to 3.5GB, not sure why at the moment, maybe because of the Unity upgrade, I will investigate.
